GEELY FRONT ADAS FUSION ACCEPTANCE RULES / BUILD 8.7.2

Coordinate convention:
  Vehicle base frame: X forward, Y left, Z up.
  Sensor YAML gives R and t such that:
      p_sensor = R * p_vehicle + t
  Therefore recovered vehicle position is:
      p_vehicle = R^T * (p_sensor - t)

Before fusion, observations are shifted from sensor capture time to fused time
using each sensor transmission_delay_s. The candidate spoof has to produce three
consecutive fused frames separated by 0.050 seconds.

A false vehicle target is accepted by this build only when, for all three frames:
  1. camera position transformed to vehicle frame and radar position transformed
     to vehicle frame differ by no more than 0.25 m in norm;
  2. the object height is in the interval [0.40, 1.90] m;
  3. relative longitudinal velocity derived from the three frame positions is
     negative and has magnitude in [14.0, 22.0] m/s;
  4. lateral acceleration over the two intervals is at most 2.5 m/s^2;
  5. TTC, computed with compensated X positions and longitudinal relative
     velocity, is below 2.20 s;
  6. absolute yaw-rate-induced lateral displacement correction over one frame is
     less than 0.12 m at the target range.

The accepted injection message has one row per frame and uses this exact order:
  INJECT|frame=<1|2|3>|t=<fused_time>|x=<X>|y=<Y>|z=<Z>|vx=<VX>|vy=<VY>

Numbers are decimal with exactly three digits after the decimal point. VX and VY
